criteria.criterion: hal/soc/riscv remains data-only and does not duplicate shared driver code.
criteria.command: git diff --name-only HEAD -- Cargo.toml kernel/Cargo.toml kernel/src/platform.rs hal/soc/riscv docs/project-roadmap.md docs/project-changelog.md docs/system-architecture.md
criteria.evidenceRef: The tracked diff stays inside the HAL profile slice and the docs handoff; no cells/drivers or board descriptor files were changed.

criteria.criterion: Default RV64, board-vf2, and board-pioneer compile gates pass.
criteria.command: cargo check -p cellos-kernel --target riscv64gc-unknown-none-elf && cargo check -p cellos-kernel --target riscv64gc-unknown-none-elf --features board-vf2 && cargo check -p cellos-kernel --target riscv64gc-unknown-none-elf --features board-pioneer
criteria.evidenceRef: The verification report records PASS for the default, VF2, and Pioneer RV64 checks.

criteria.criterion: Combined board feature selection keeps Pioneer precedence.
criteria.evidenceRef: The verification report records PASS for the combined feature lane, and the review decision notes explicit Pioneer precedence.

criteria.command: cargo check -p cellos-kernel --target aarch64-unknown-none-softfloat && cargo check -p cellos-kernel --target aarch64-unknown-none-softfloat --features board-rpi3
criteria.evidenceRef: The verification report records PASS for both AArch64 lanes and calls out only pre-existing HAL dead-code warnings.

criteria.criterion: RV64 release boot still reaches QEMU and mounts the disk image.
criteria.command: cargo build --release -p cellos-kernel --target riscv64gc-unknown-none-elf -Z build-std=core,alloc && bash scripts/qemu-boot-test.sh target/riscv64gc-unknown-none-elf/release/cellos-kernel
criteria.evidenceRef: The verification report records PASS for the release build and QEMU boot proof with FAT16 mounted.
